name: Can I remove mold from my office building myself, or do I need professionals?

mainEntity.name: Can I remove mold from my office building myself, or do I need professionals?

acceptedAnswer.text: While small, surface mold patches (less than 10 square feet) might be manageable for trained maintenance staff using appropriate safety gear, extensive mold growth in an office building typically requires professional remediation. Commercial mold issues often involve larger areas, hidden mold, or contamination within HVAC systems, which necessitate specialized equipment, containment protocols, and expert knowledge to safely remove and prevent recurrence. Attempting to clean large mold infestations without proper training can spread spores and worsen the problem. Professionals ensure thorough and safe removal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small mold patches might be DIY, but extensive or hidden mold in an office requires professional remediation to prevent spread and ensure safety.
